question: What claim about transmission is at stake in asserting that a teaching concerning the earth-movers and good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: Teachings concerning the earth-movers and the good-eaters are posited.
The agent of telling is described as an earth-mover.
inference: A teaching concerning the earth-movers and the good-eaters was transmitted by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The specific content of that teaching is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: O beloved, concerning the earth-movers and the good-eaters, it was told by an earth-mover.
